name: The Unfolding Home, Slupsk (traced)
note: Traced by hand on the cached plan (1280 x 905 px, evals/real/fetch.ts), scale from the plan's 0-1-2 m bar (115 px for 2 m = 57.5 px/m; bed 1.6 x 2.0 m and doors 0.8-0.9 m agree). No printed areas; traced net total about 65 m2 (= published 65). Outer walls at inner faces, partitions on their centre lines. The bathroom (tub, shower, WC behind a curved screen) is one room; the bedroom's built-in wardrobe and the vestibule in front of its door stay in the bedroom / hall; the corridor behind the kitchen block, the curtained reading nook, kitchen, dining and sofa area are one open room (curtains are not walls). Balcony left out, its glazing kept (south as a door, east as a window). Kitchen as drawn: a freestanding black volume (tall units facing the corridor, a tall unit and a hob counter facing the kitchen aisle) and an island with the sink.
